title: 第470章 大师兄安排的任务第469章 生命灵液灵霞丹
slug: 九脉被夺我以魔种证无敌
lines: 鼎内天地，药田。
装着十滴生命灵液的玉瓶，仿佛被一只无形的手掌抓着，瓶口倾斜，一滴晶莹剔透的液体，往下滴落。
生命灵液滴落在回魂神果的叶片上。
顿时，回魂神果的叶片那一条条金色的脉络，顿时涌动着流淌的金光。
金光耀眼，纯净，散发着一股玄妙之意。
一滴接着一滴的生命灵液，滴落在回魂神果的叶片上，被回魂神果吸收，与此同时，堆积在旁边的一座座元晶大山，也在剧烈地闪烁着白光。
元晶内的能量，被快速吸收，每一个眨眼间，都有上千万的元晶被消耗掉。
足足消耗了接近十亿的元晶，以及六滴生命灵液后，回魂神果的顶端，终于，生长出了一个小小的花苞。
花苞还未绽放，就已散发出沁人心脾的芬芳。
秦逸站在一旁，深吸了一口气，顿时便感觉神清气爽。
“差不多了。”
鼎爷的声音响起。
“花苞刚诞生，还剩下四滴生命灵液，后续再用于浇灌，但元晶又快没了，你得抓紧多凑一点。”
“以后有时间，就去天榜空间，弄点积分，继续兑换生命灵液，如果有足够的生命灵液，三个月内，便可以让回魂神果，完全成熟。”
“当然，即便没有生命灵液了，回魂神果也能成熟，就是需要花的时间比较久。”
秦逸立刻问道：“鼎爷，想要在三个月内，让回魂神果成熟，还差多少生命灵液？”
三个月内，若能得到一颗能让人相当于拥有第二条命的神药，这对秦逸来说，非常重要。
多一条命，不管做什么事，底气都能大增！
鼎爷：“一百滴到一百五十滴之间吧。”
秦逸目光一闪。
一滴生命灵液，十点积分。
为了在三个月内，催熟回魂神果，也就是还需要一千点积分到一千五百点积分。
而在天榜空间，一颗回魂神果，价值一万点积分。
怎么算，这都是非常划算的！
这还是为了尽快催熟，才需要使用较多的生命灵液！
“好，我明白了！”
秦逸点头。
“不感觉有压力？”
鼎爷问道。
秦逸摇了摇头，道：“这是救命的东西，更何况，鼎爷您帮我培育回魂神果，比我自己去天榜空间兑换，便宜了太多。”
“我不能既要还要！”
“鼎爷您放心吧，以我现在的实力，在天榜空间内，赚几千点积分，没有难度。”
秦逸在这药田中，看了一会回魂神果，然后便离开了药田。
“也差不多要启程，回荒古大陆一趟了！”
“先去跟师尊，以及两位师兄，打一声招呼！”
content_en:
Inside the cauldron, there is heaven and earth, a medicinal field.
The jade bottle containing ten drops of life spirit liquid seemed to be held by an invisible hand. The mouth of the bottle was tilted, and a drop of crystal clear liquid dripped down.
Life spirit fluid drips on the leaves of the soul-reviving divine fruit.
Suddenly, the golden veins on the leaves of the Soul Resurrection Fruit suddenly surged with flowing golden light.
The golden light is dazzling, pure, and exudes a mysterious meaning.
Drop after drop of life spirit fluid dripped on the leaves of the Soul Resurrection Divine Fruit, and was absorbed by the Soul Resurrection Divine Fruit. At the same time, the mountains of Yuanjing accumulated next to it were also flashing white light violently.
The energy in the Yuanjing was quickly absorbed, and in every blink of an eye, tens of millions of Yuanjing were consumed.
After consuming nearly a billion yuan crystals and six drops of life spirit liquid, a small bud finally grew on the top of the soul-returning divine fruit.
Even before the buds bloom, they are already emitting a refreshing fragrance.
Qin Yi stood aside, took a deep breath, and suddenly felt refreshed.
"Almost."
Lord Ding's voice sounded.
"The flower bud has just been born, and there are still four drops of life spirit liquid left, which will be used for watering later, but the Yuanjing is almost gone, so you have to hurry up and collect more."
"If you have time in the future, go to the Tianbang space, get some points, and continue to redeem the life spirit liquid. If you have enough life spirit liquid, you can fully mature the soul-returning fruit within three months."
"Of course, even if there is no life spirit liquid, the soul-reviving divine fruit can still mature, but it will take a longer time."
Qin Yi immediately asked: "Master Ding, if you want the soul-returning divine fruit to mature within three months, how much life spirit liquid is needed?"
Within three months, it would be very important to Qin Yi if he could get a magic medicine that would give people the equivalent of a second life.
With one more life, no matter what you do, your confidence will be greatly increased!
Master Ding: "It should be between one hundred drops and one hundred and fifty drops."
Qin Yi's eyes flashed.
One drop of life spirit liquid, ten points.
In order to ripen the soul-reviving divine fruit within three months, one thousand to fifteen hundred points are needed.
In the Tianbang space, a soul-reviving divine fruit is worth 10,000 points.
No matter how you calculate it, this is a very good deal!
This is to accelerate ripening as quickly as possible, so more life spirit liquid needs to be used!
"Okay, I understand!"
Qin Yi nodded.
"Don't you feel any pressure?"
Lord Ding asked.
Qin Yi shook his head and said: "This is a life-saving thing. What's more, Lord Ding, you can help me cultivate the soul-returning fruit. It's much cheaper than going to the Tianbang space to exchange it myself."
"I can't have both!"
"Don't worry, Master Ding. With my current strength, it's not difficult to earn thousands of points in the Tianbang space."
Qin Yi looked at the Soul-Reviving Divine Fruit in the medicine field for a while, and then left the medicine field.
"It's almost time to set off, back to the ancient continent!"
"Go and say hello to Master and the two senior brothers first!"
